"""Per-cell MLP stem, one residual 3x3 context conv, and a top-left-anchored 2x2 footprint head."""
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

WIDTH = 64
FOOT = 32


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        W = WIDTH
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, W, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(W, W, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.ctx = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.foot = nn.Conv2d(W, FOOT, 2)
        self.place_head = nn.Conv2d(FOOT, spec.n_types, 1)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * W, W), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(W, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(W, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        h = self.stem(obs)
        f = h + F.relu(self.ctx(h))
        p = F.relu(self.foot(F.pad(f, (0, 1, 0, 1))))
        place = self.place_head(p).flatten(1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

"""Residual 3x3 conv net (width 48) with mask channels as input and a global-context broadcast between blocks."""
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

WIDTH = 48


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        W = WIDTH
        self.n_types = spec.n_types
        self.n_place = spec.n_place
        self.Y = spec.Y
        self.X = spec.X
        self.stem = nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels + spec.n_types, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.block1 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.bcast = nn.Linear(2 * W, W)
        self.block2 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.place_head = nn.Conv2d(W, spec.n_types, 1)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * W, W), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(W, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(W, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B = obs.shape[0]
        m = mask[:, :self.n_place].to(obs.dtype).reshape(B, self.n_types, self.Y, self.X)
        x = torch.cat([obs, m], dim=1)
        f = F.relu(self.stem(x))
        f = f + F.relu(self.block1(f))
        g0 = F.relu(self.bcast(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1)))
        f = f + g0[:, :, None, None]
        f = f + F.relu(self.block2(f))
        place = self.place_head(f).flatten(1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

A shared MLP with a per-type bias then outputs that type's logits. The max gives the landing height. """Per-cell stem, residual 3x3 context with global broadcast, and per-type footprint max/min pooling head."""
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

WIDTH = 64
PW = 32
HID = 48


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        W = WIDTH
        self.footprints = [(int(fp[0]), int(fp[1])) for fp in spec.footprints]
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, W, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(W, W, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.ctx = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.bcast = nn.Linear(2 * W, W)
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(W, PW, 1)
        self.mix = nn.Conv2d(2 * PW + W, HID, 1)
        self.type_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(spec.n_types, HID, 1, 1))
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HID, 1, 1) for _ in range(spec.n_types)])
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * W, W), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(W, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(W, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        h = self.stem(obs)
        f = h + F.relu(self.ctx(h))
        g0 = F.relu(self.bcast(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1)))
        f = f + g0[:, :, None, None]
        p = self.proj(f)
        place = []
        for t, (dy, dx) in enumerate(self.footprints):
            pp = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
            mx = F.max_pool2d(pp, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            mn = -F.max_pool2d(-pp, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            z = F.relu(self.mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, f], dim=1)) + self.type_bias[t])
            place.append(self.outs[t](z).flatten(1))
        place = torch.cat(place, dim=1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

"""Per-cell stem with mask input, three residual 3x3 blocks with global broadcasts, 2x2 footprint head."""
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

WIDTH = 48
FOOT = 32
N_BLOCKS = 3


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        W = WIDTH
        self.n_types = spec.n_types
        self.n_place = spec.n_place
        self.Y = spec.Y
        self.X = spec.X
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels + spec.n_types, W, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(W, W, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1) for _ in range(N_BLOCKS)])
        self.bcasts = nn.ModuleList([nn.Linear(2 * W, W) for _ in range(N_BLOCKS - 1)])
        self.foot = nn.Conv2d(W, FOOT, 2)
        self.place_head = nn.Conv2d(FOOT + W, spec.n_types, 1)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * W, W), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(W, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(W, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B = obs.shape[0]
        m = mask[:, :self.n_place].to(obs.dtype).reshape(B, self.n_types, self.Y, self.X)
        f = self.stem(torch.cat([obs, m], dim=1))
        for i, conv in enumerate(self.blocks):
            f = f + F.relu(conv(f))
            if i < len(self.bcasts):
                g0 = F.relu(self.bcasts[i](torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1)))
                f = f + g0[:, :, None, None]
        p = F.relu(self.foot(F.pad(f, (0, 1, 0, 1))))
        place = self.place_head(torch.cat([p, f], dim=1)).flatten(1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

"""Footprint max/min pooling head with the per-cell part of the mix factored out (cheaper r2c1); zero-init placement outputs."""
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

WIDTH = 64
PW = 32
HID = 48


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        W = WIDTH
        self.footprints = [(int(fp[0]), int(fp[1])) for fp in spec.footprints]
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, W, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(W, W, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.ctx = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.bcast = nn.Linear(2 * W, W)
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(W, PW, 1)
        self.mixp = nn.Conv2d(2 * PW, HID, 1)
        self.mixf = nn.Conv2d(W, HID, 1)
        self.type_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(spec.n_types, HID, 1, 1))
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HID, 1, 1) for _ in range(spec.n_types)])
        for o in self.outs:
            nn.init.zeros_(o.weight)
            nn.init.zeros_(o.bias)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * W, W), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(W, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(W, 1)

        h = self.stem(obs)
        f = h + F.relu(self.ctx(h))
        g0 = F.relu(self.bcast(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1)))
        f = f + g0[:, :, None, None]
        p = self.proj(f)
        base = self.mixf(f)
        place = []
        for t, (dy, dx) in enumerate(self.footprints):
            pp = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
            mx = F.max_pool2d(pp, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            mn = -F.max_pool2d(-pp, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            z = F.relu(self.mixp(torch.cat([mx, mn], dim=1)) + base + self.type_bias[t])
            place.append(self.outs[t](z).flatten(1))
        place = torch.cat(place, dim=1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)

    return Net(spec)

Footprint max/min pooling runs at each layer, a score is computed per layer, and a log-sum-exp over layers gives the anchor's logit. """Per-layer token features with footprint max/min pooling at every layer, combined by log-sum-exp over layers."""
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

WIDTH = 48
LW = 32
PW = 24
HID = 24


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        W = WIDTH
        self.Z = spec.Z
        self.Y = spec.Y
        self.X = spec.X
        self.n_types = spec.n_types
        self.footprints = [(int(fp[0]), int(fp[1])) for fp in spec.footprints]
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, W, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.ctx = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.bcast = nn.Linear(2 * W, W)
        self.lay_in = nn.Conv2d(8 + spec.Z, LW, 1)
        self.lay_f = nn.Conv2d(W, LW, 1)
        self.lay2 = nn.Conv2d(LW, PW, 1)
        self.mix = nn.Conv2d(2 * PW, HID, 1)
        self.type_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(spec.n_types, HID, 1, 1))
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HID, 1, 1) for _ in range(spec.n_types)])
        self.head2d = nn.Conv2d(W, spec.n_types, 1)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * W, W), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(W, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(W, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B = obs.shape[0]
        Z, Y, X = self.Z, self.Y, self.X
        h = self.stem(obs)
        f = h + F.relu(self.ctx(h))
        g0 = F.relu(self.bcast(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1)))
        f = f + g0[:, :, None, None]

        build = obs[:, 0:Z]
        tgt = obs[:, Z:2 * Z]
        miss = obs[:, 2 * Z:3 * Z]
        extra = obs[:, 3 * Z:4 * Z]
        below = F.pad(build, (0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0), value=1.0)[:, :Z]
        per = torch.stack([build, tgt, miss, extra, below], dim=2)
        g3 = obs[:, 4 * Z:4 * Z + 3].unsqueeze(1).expand(B, Z, 3, Y, X)
        zid = torch.eye(Z, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, Z, Z, 1, 1).expand(B, Z, Z, Y, X)
        tok = torch.cat([per, g3, zid], dim=2).reshape(B * Z, 8 + Z, Y, X)
        fz = self.lay_f(f).unsqueeze(1).expand(B, Z, LW, Y, X).reshape(B * Z, LW, Y, X)
        u = F.relu(self.lay_in(tok) + fz)
        u = F.relu(self.lay2(u))

        scores = []
        for t, (dy, dx) in enumerate(self.footprints):
            pp = F.pad(u, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
            mx = F.max_pool2d(pp, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            mn = -F.max_pool2d(-pp, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            zz = F.relu(self.mix(torch.cat([mx, mn], dim=1)) + self.type_bias[t])
            s = self.outs[t](zz).reshape(B, Z, Y * X)
            scores.append(torch.logsumexp(s, dim=1))
        place = torch.stack(scores, dim=1) + self.head2d(f).flatten(2)
        place = place.flatten(1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

        self.ctx = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.bcast = nn.Linear(2 * W, W)
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(W, PW, 1)
        self.mixp = nn.Conv2d(2 * PW, HID, 1)
        self.mixf = nn.Conv2d(W, HID, 1)
        self.type_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(spec.n_types, HID, 1, 1))
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HID, 1, 1) for _ in range(spec.n_types)])
        for o in self.outs:
            nn.init.zeros_(o.weight)
            nn.init.zeros_(o.bias)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * W, W), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(W, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(W, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        h = self.stem(obs)
        f = h + F.relu(self.ctx(h))
        g0 = F.relu(self.bcast(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1)))
        f = f + g0[:, :, None, None]
        p = self.proj(f)
        base = self.mixf(f)
        place = []
        for t, (dy, dx) in enumerate(self.footprints):
            pp = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
            mx = F.max_pool2d(pp, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            mn = -F.max_pool2d(-pp, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            z = F.relu(self.mixp(torch.cat([mx, mn], dim=1)) + base + self.type_bias[t])
            place.append(self.outs[t](z).flatten(1))
        place = torch.cat(place, dim=1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

"""Factored footprint max/min pooling head, 2 PPO epochs, legal-action mask as stem input channels."""
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

WIDTH = 64
PW = 32
HID = 48

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 2}


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        W = WIDTH
        self.n_types = spec.n_types
        self.n_place = spec.n_place
        self.Y = spec.Y
        self.X = spec.X
        self.footprints = [(int(fp[0]), int(fp[1])) for fp in spec.footprints]
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels + spec.n_types, W, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(W, W, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.ctx = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.bcast = nn.Linear(2 * W, W)
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(W, PW, 1)
        self.mixp = nn.Conv2d(2 * PW, HID, 1)
        self.mixf = nn.Conv2d(W, HID, 1)
        self.type_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(spec.n_types, HID, 1, 1))
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HID, 1, 1) for _ in range(spec.n_types)])
        for o in self.outs:
            nn.init.zeros_(o.weight)
            nn.init.zeros_(o.bias)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * W, W), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(W, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(W, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B = obs.shape[0]
        m = mask[:, :self.n_place].to(obs.dtype).reshape(B, self.n_types, self.Y, self.X)
        h = self.stem(torch.cat([obs, m], dim=1))
        f = h + F.relu(self.ctx(h))
        g0 = F.relu(self.bcast(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1)))
        f = f + g0[:, :, None, None]
        p = self.proj(f)
        base = self.mixf(f)
        place = []
        for t, (dy, dx) in enumerate(self.footprints):
            pp = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
            mx = F.max_pool2d(pp, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            mn = -F.max_pool2d(-pp, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            z = F.relu(self.mixp(torch.cat([mx, mn], dim=1)) + base + self.type_bias[t])
            place.append(self.outs[t](z).flatten(1))
        place = torch.cat(place, dim=1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

"""Per-layer token features with footprint max/min pooling per layer, log-sum-exp over layers; zero-init outputs, 2 PPO epochs."""
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

WIDTH = 48
LW = 32
PW = 24
HID = 24

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 2}


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        W = WIDTH
        self.Z = spec.Z
        self.Y = spec.Y
        self.X = spec.X
        self.n_types = spec.n_types
        self.footprints = [(int(fp[0]), int(fp[1])) for fp in spec.footprints]
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, W, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.ctx = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.bcast = nn.Linear(2 * W, W)
        self.lay_in = nn.Conv2d(8 + spec.Z, LW, 1)
        self.lay_f = nn.Conv2d(W, LW, 1)
        self.lay2 = nn.Conv2d(LW, PW, 1)
        self.mix = nn.Conv2d(2 * PW, HID, 1)
        self.type_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(spec.n_types, HID, 1, 1))
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HID, 1, 1) for _ in range(spec.n_types)])
        for o in self.outs:
            nn.init.zeros_(o.weight)
            nn.init.zeros_(o.bias)
        self.head2d = nn.Conv2d(W, spec.n_types, 1)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.head2d.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.head2d.bias)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * W, W), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(W, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(W, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B = obs.shape[0]
        Z, Y, X = self.Z, self.Y, self.X
        h = self.stem(obs)
        f = h + F.relu(self.ctx(h))
        g0 = F.relu(self.bcast(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1)))
        f = f + g0[:, :, None, None]

        build = obs[:, 0:Z]
        tgt = obs[:, Z:2 * Z]
        miss = obs[:, 2 * Z:3 * Z]
        extra = obs[:, 3 * Z:4 * Z]
        below = F.pad(build, (0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0), value=1.0)[:, :Z]
        per = torch.stack([build, tgt, miss, extra, below], dim=2)
        g3 = obs[:, 4 * Z:4 * Z + 3].unsqueeze(1).expand(B, Z, 3, Y, X)
        zid = torch.eye(Z, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, Z, Z, 1, 1).expand(B, Z, Z, Y, X)
        tok = torch.cat([per, g3, zid], dim=2).reshape(B * Z, 8 + Z, Y, X)
        fz = self.lay_f(f).unsqueeze(1).expand(B, Z, LW, Y, X).reshape(B * Z, LW, Y, X)
        u = F.relu(self.lay_in(tok) + fz)
        u = F.relu(self.lay2(u))

        scores = []
        for t, (dy, dx) in enumerate(self.footprints):
            pp = F.pad(u, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
            mx = F.max_pool2d(pp, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            mn = -F.max_pool2d(-pp, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            zz = F.relu(self.mix(torch.cat([mx, mn], dim=1)) + self.type_bias[t])
            s = self.outs[t](zz).reshape(B, Z, Y * X)
            scores.append(torch.logsumexp(s, dim=1))
        place = torch.stack(scores, dim=1) + self.head2d(f).flatten(2)
        place = place.flatten(1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

analyses.1:
There are no results yet, and scores stay hidden, so this round tests three separate ideas against the starting network. The budget is small: 131k steps, which is 32 updates under the default recipe. A network cheaper than the starting one gets no extra samples, so each candidate stays at about the same compute (r ≈ 1). The agent must work out, for each anchor and brick type, two things: whether the brick would land on the target layer, and whether every cell under its footprint is missing at that layer. It also needs some wider context so that placement order doesn't seal holes, and a global view to decide DONE. The three candidates are:
1. The same network with more frequent, smaller PPO updates, to test sample efficiency.
2. Per-cell 1x1 layers before the convolution, plus a placement head that reads the brick's 2x2 footprint from its top-left anchor.
3. A deeper residual network with whole-grid context added back to every cell, and the legal-action mask fed in as input.
analyses.2: All three round-1 trials trained without errors, but scores are hidden, so I can't rank them. Each change was small and kept compute near the starting level (r ≤ 1.07). That leaves room to try stronger structural ideas. A correct placement depends on the whole footprint: the brick lands at the maximum build height under it, and every covered cell must be missing at that layer. If the heights under the footprint differ, the brick leaves cells beneath it that can never be filled. The network can express this as a maximum and a minimum over the footprint. Max/min pooling applied after learned layers is allowed and costs few FLOPs. So this round tests a footprint min/max pooling head twice: once with the default recipe, and once with a recipe that updates more often with fewer epochs. The third trial combines the round-1 ideas into one deeper net: the per-cell stem, mask input, global broadcast and 2x2 footprint conv. That keeps the architectures varied for the final top-3 reseeding.
analyses.3: All six trials trained without errors, but no scores are shown, so I can't rank them. I have to reason from task structure and the compute budget. Being exact needs three things for each anchor: the landing layer (the maximum build height under the footprint), whether every covered cell is missing at exactly that layer, and whether the placement seals cells below it. The footprint max/min pooling head in r2c1 matches this best, but its compute ratio of 1.45 cost about 30% of the samples. Deeper nets cost even more. With roughly 130k steps, samples are probably scarce. So this round: (1) the same function class as r2c1, computed more cheaply, to isolate the sample-count effect; (2) its twin with 2 PPO epochs, giving many more samples, to test reuse against data; (3) a new idea covering what nothing so far has tried: per-layer features scored at every height and combined with a smooth max over layers, so the network can learn the rule "the brick lands at layer L and fills target cells there".
analyses.4:
I can't see any scores, so I'm choosing these from structure, not results. Every trial so far trained without errors. Rounds 2 and 3 settled on footprint max/min pooling heads. r3c2 has the best design reasoning behind it: a cheap factored head, zero-initialised placement outputs, and 2 PPO epochs giving about 192k steps. Its compute ratio is about 1.26, and it fit easily inside the time limit. Seed noise is large, so any one comparison is weak. The last round should therefore give the final top-3 selection several good chances, not test risky new architectures.

Two parts of the setup have not been tested yet:
1. The discount. With gamma 0.95, the +1 exact-build bonus shrinks to about 0.36 when it is 20 steps away. That gives the agent little reason to avoid wrong cells early or to stop at the right moment.
2. The legal-action mask as an input, used on the best head.

I also rerun the per-layer head (r3c3) with the r3c2 recipe changes, because explicit per-layer reasoning fits the stacking structure of the task.
